description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-043 (Create Accession) where accessionNumber already exists within organization + branch. Same endpoint as API-043, isolated here to preserve the original docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering.

body.accessionNumber: string - duplicate of an existing accession_number in this scenario

validation: accessionNumber must be unique within organization + branch (UNIQUE uq_accession_number)

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-043 for the success contract

errors.condition: accessionNumber already exists within organization + branch
